description: Reorder the stocks in 'My Watchlist' to prioritize the AI sector. Move 'Microsoft Corp.' (MSFT) to the very top (first row), followed immediately by 'NVIDIA Corp.' (NVDA) in the second row, and 'Apple Inc.' (AAPL) in the third row. The remaining stocks (GOOGL, AMZN) can follow in any order. Ensure the new order is saved.
